title: Adjacent differential identity for explicit localized Koszul evaluation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbb N$, $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$, and $F$ an integer-indexed complex of sheaves of modules on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Fix $e\in\mathbb N$ and the extended negative Koszul tail $I_e$ [def-sc-koszul-open-system], at exponent $e+1$. For every nonempty $J\subseteq\operatorname{Fin}(r)$, let $B_J\in I_e^{1-|J|}$ be its increasing exterior basis vector transported through extension by zero. Put $M=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}(A),F)$ and let $H_e=\operatorname{Hom}_A^\bullet(I_e,M)$ [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex]. Let $C(F)$ be the explicitly defined alternating principal-open total complex [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total]. Define $\lambda_{e,n}:H_e^n\to C(F)^n$ by restricting $z(B_J)$ to $D(\prod_{j\in J} f_j)$, applying the inverse of multiplication by $(\prod_{j\in J}f_j)^{e+1}$ on that section module, and multiplying by $(-1)^{pq+p(p-1)/2}$, where $p=|J|-1$ and $q=n-p$. These are explicit $A$-linear maps. For every integer $n$, prove $\lambda_{e,n+1}\circ d_{H_e}^{n}=d_{C(F)}^{n}\circ\lambda_{e,n}$. No quasi-coherence or boundedness of $F$ is assumed. The Lean statement allows a family $B$ equipped with its equality to the displayed ordered wedge, so the identity applies to the existing basis definition without defining it again.

source.place: Tags 08CX, 08D0 and 08D1: diagonal power transitions, principal-open fraction map and totalization sign; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D1.

proof.text: Use ModuleCat.hom_ext, LinearMap.ext, and function extensionality to compare the two maps on a cochain z and a nonempty subset J. Expand the chosen Cech differential by principalCechDifferential_exists.choose_spec, and the Hom differential by Mathlib HomComplex.δ_v. A-linearity of restriction and scalar division splits the evaluation into postcomposition and precomposition terms.

Identify the postcomposition term with the vertical Cech term by koszulCechLocalized_vertical, applied to z(B_J). This part is fully proved by coefficient naturality, inverse scalar naturality, and S(p,n+1)=S(p,n)+p.

For card(J)=1, prove the outgoing extended-tail differential is zero using extend_d_from_eq_zero at tail degree zero; every erased subset has cardinality zero, so the horizontal Cech sum is zero. For card(J)>1, identify the precomposition term with the horizontal Cech sum by koszulCechLocalized_boundary, using hB. Combine the two term equalities with congrArg₂ addition.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulCechLocalizedDegreeMap_comm (e : ℕ)
    (B : ∀ J : {J : Finset (Fin r) // J.Nonempty},
      ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat).X
        (1 - (J.val.card : ℤ)))
    (hB : ∀ J, B J =
      ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
        (show ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat.f (J.val.card - 1) =
          1 - (J.val.card : ℤ) by
          simp only [ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat_f]
          have h : 0 < J.val.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr J.property
          omega)).inv
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti A (J.val.card - 1 + 1)
          (fun i ↦ Finsupp.single (J.val.orderEmbOfFin
            (show J.val.card = J.val.card - 1 + 1 by
              have h : 0 < J.val.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr J.property
              omega) i) (1 : A)))) (n : ℤ) :
    (CochainComplex.moduleHomComplex
      ((koszulOpenTail A r f e).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F)).d
        n (n + 1) ≫ koszulCechLocalizedDegreeMap A r f F e (n + 1) B =
      koszulCechLocalizedDegreeMap A r f F e n B ≫ (principalCechTotal r f F).d
        n (n + 1)
